findings.summary: The persistent 300 px sidebar leaves a 468 px main column; controls, labels, metric cards, tabs, and table content wrap or clip aggressively.
Only ten of 27 destinations are visible before the generic 'View 17 more' disclosure, weakening information scent and page discoverability.
The floating AI control occupies the lower-right content area and can overlap dense cards or charts.
Streamlit emits two route-relative 404 probes per capture for _stcore/health and _stcore/host-config; rendered content and readiness remain intact.
No page-level horizontal overflow or sidebar/main overlap was measured at 1440 x 900; visual density and hierarchy remain inconsistent by page.
